fitness_doc: GA cost, mean over the aircraft's scenarios; lower is better

frame.body_axes: JSBSim body FRD: x forward, y right wing, z down
frame.attitude_source_of_truth: quaternion; phi/theta/psi are HUD-only (JSBSim Euler ZYX vs local NED)

target.reference: ramped at 600 fpm with 0.1 g corners (channel target_alt_m = reference, target_cmd_alt_m = command)

control_conventions: JSBSim fcs/*-cmd-norm: elevator + = trailing-edge down (nose down); aileron + = right roll; rudder + = per model; throttle 0..1

events.detail: trimmed level flight 4000 ft, 100 KCAS, throttle 0.780

controls_timing_doc: throttle/elevator/aileron/rudder in the row at time t are the commands applied over the sim step that STARTS at t (set by the controller from the state at t). A recorder called after the step ending at t reads, in fcs/*-cmd-norm, the commands of that ended step (= the previous row's controls). The final row repeats the last applied commands. State channels are the state at t.

channel_doc.target_alt_m: altitude REFERENCE the controller tracks at t, m MSL (sim.Scenario.target): the ramped reference (Phase-1: 600 fpm with 0.1 g corners) moving toward target_cmd_alt_m; equals target_cmd_alt_m when the scenario has no ramp. The tracking cost and hold metrics use this channel.
channel_doc.nz: normal load factor, g (accelerations/Nz; +1.0 in level flight, + = pull-up).
channel_doc.ub: body x velocity (forward), m/s, Earth-relative (velocities/u-fps), body FRD axes.
channel_doc.vb: body y velocity (right), m/s, Earth-relative (velocities/v-fps), body FRD axes.
channel_doc.wb: body z velocity (down), m/s, Earth-relative (velocities/w-fps), body FRD axes.
channel_doc.target_cmd_alt_m: COMMANDED altitude at t, m MSL (sim.Scenario.target_cmd): the instant step input (h0 + steps_rel_ft); the reference target_alt_m ramps toward it.
channel_doc.target_rate_mps: reference climb rate d(target_alt_m)/dt, m/s (+ up); 0 while the reference is at rest or without a ramp.

units.axis_nodes_body_m: m, body FRD (x fwd, y right, z down), origin CG

structure.dz_doc: elastic deflection of the elastic axis relative to the undeformed (jig) shape, including the 1-g trim deflection; = -w (FD w is + up)
structure.dy_doc: modal wings: 0.0 (in-plane not in the 9-node modal map). FE wings (full, v2_map): use dx.
structure.dx_doc: FE wing in-plane (full only, v2_map): dx = -v * 0.3048 (FD v + aft -> body + forward)
structure.twist_doc: twist [rad]: right-hand rotation about the component axis node0 -> nodeN (root -> tip). wingR: + = leading edge up; wingL: + = leading edge DOWN. FD raw twist (flexwing v1 PsiT@eta and flexbody v2 Surface.PsiT@eta, tip_twist_*_deg) is + = leading edge up / nose-up (increases local alpha: G = cos(sweep)*PsiT - sin(sweep)*dPhiW) on BOTH semi-wings, so wingR.twist = +theta_R, wingL.twist = -theta_L. Same signs in sim-bridge v2_map (V2_MAP_VERSION) for FE nodal wings.
structure.raw_channels_doc: flex.<key> = FD coupler diagnostics as FD names them (root loads lbf*ft incl. tail and fuselage, tip deflections ft, twists/incidences deg); see INTERFACE_v2.md

sign_table.fd: htR / htL theta_deg (+ LE up, both sides)

sign_table.sb: struct.ht_incidence = +rad; carried into htail/vtail dz as -inc * (x - x_tail)
struct.vt_incidence = +rad, struct.vt_sideslip_equiv = -rad; carried into htail/vtail dy as +inc * (x - x_tail)

sign_table.fd: dL / dY (lbf), dRoll / dPitch / dYaw (lbf*ft) at / about the AERORP
sign_table.sb: struct.elastic_* N / N*m, FD (JSBSim l, m, n) sign kept
sign_table.sb_plus: up / +y / right wing down / nose up / nose right

struct.wingR_root_torque.plus: root torque about the EA, + = nose-up (LE up)

struct.wingL_root_torque.plus: root torque about the EA, + = nose-up (LE up)

struct.wingR_root_ip_bm.plus: in-plane root bending, + = aft load (tip bends aft)

struct.wingL_root_ip_bm.plus: in-plane root bending, + = aft load (tip bends aft)

struct.htR_root_bm.plus: right HT root bending, + = up-bending (perturbation from trim)

struct.htL_root_bm.plus: left HT root bending, + = up-bending (perturbation from trim)

struct.vt_root_bm.plus: fin root bending, + = load / tip toward body +y

struct.fusV_root_bm.plus: aft-fuselage vertical bending at the wing station, + = tail up

struct.fusL_root_bm.plus: aft-fuselage lateral bending at the wing station, + = tail +y

struct.wingR_tip_dz.plus: right wing tip, body z + down (FD w + up)

struct.wingL_tip_dz.plus: left wing tip, body z + down (FD w + up)

struct.wingL_tip_twist.plus: right-hand root->tip (-y): + = LE DOWN (FD + = LE up)

struct.wingR_tip_dx.plus: right wing tip in-plane, body x + forward (FD + aft)

struct.wingL_tip_dx.plus: left wing tip in-plane, body x + forward (FD + aft)

struct.htR_tip_dz.plus: right HT tip rel. its root (excl. fuselage), body z + down

struct.htL_tip_dz.plus: left HT tip rel. its root (excl. fuselage), body z + down

struct.htR_tip_twist.plus: right HT elastic twist, + = LE up (htail polyline +y)

struct.htL_tip_twist.plus: left HT elastic twist, + = LE up (htail polyline +y)

struct.vt_tip_dy.plus: fin tip rel. its root (excl. fuselage), body y + right

struct.vt_tip_twist.plus: fin elastic twist, right-hand about root->tip (up): + = LE toward -y (FD + = LE toward +y)

struct.fusV_tip_dz.plus: aft-fuselage tip (tail) vertical, body z + down

struct.fusL_tip_dy.plus: aft-fuselage tip (tail) lateral, body y + right

struct.ht_incidence.plus: tail incidence from the fuselage slope, + = nose-up (raises tail alpha; = -w'_fusV,tip)

struct.vt_incidence.plus: fin incidence from the fuselage slope, + = fin LE toward +y (= -w'_fusL,tip; OPPOSITE sense to aircraft beta)

struct.elastic_dlift.plus: elastic lift increment, + = up, normal to V in the body x-z plane

struct.elastic_droll.plus: elastic rolling moment (JSBSim l), + = right wing down

struct.elastic_dpitch.plus: elastic pitching moment (JSBSim m), + = nose up

struct.elastic_dyaw.plus: elastic yawing moment (JSBSim n), + = nose right

struct.vt_sideslip_equiv.plus: equivalent local sideslip increment at the fin, aircraft-beta sense (= -vt_sideslip)
